apps/console/src/shell/goto.test.ts::resolveQuery keeps a tournament-qualified ref as one segment
apps/console/src/shell/goto.test.ts::resolveQuery reads a pasted hash or console URL through decodeRoute, and offers nothing for an unknown page
apps/console/src/shell/goto.test.ts::resolveQuery routes a segment id to its table, and matches pages from the poster copy

deviations_from_card: (1) GoTo.tsx / GoTo.module.css are named GoToPalette.tsx / GoToPalette.module.css: on this case-insensitive filesystem ./GoTo and ./goto resolve to the same module (tsc TS1149/TS1261, vitest loaded goto.ts for the lazy import). (2) nextRecents lives in shell/keyActions.ts (write set), not goto.ts, so the entry does not pull the resolver in: the palette stays a lazy chunk. (3) Coupled files outside the write set: apps/console/scripts/check-bundle.mjs (names the new lazy chunk as route 'goto'; check-bundle fails on an unnamed dynamic chunk) and apps/console/budgets/bundle.json (taken under the lock, committed in the same commit because the goto line and the check-bundle route must land together). (4) keys/keymap.ts is console-app-bootstrap's file: one binding (Ctrl+k, wall/l1/l2, typing never) and one KeyAction variant ('goto'), as the card's shared_surfaces declares. (5) The palette navigates and hands focus itself (useRouter in the lazy chunk) instead of the shell, to keep the entry small.
notes: Budgets raised, measured: entry js 288,000 -> 288,500 (287,262 -> 288,293 B, +1,031: binding, effect, recents reducer/state, lazy import + preload map, Chrome button); new route goto 8,000 js / 2,500 css (7,258 / 1,879 B: palette + kit/events chunk shared with pages); onair.l2 js 103,000 -> 103,500 (103,099 B: the palette shares react+router with the entry so rolldown splits the shared cx chunk in two, ~+100 B import glue in On Air l2). Baseline was measured with my files reverted on the same tree (sibling contract work present in both). Entry css 38.5 -> 38.6 KiB (Chrome button shares the wall button rule). DOM: wall budget unchanged (button adds 1 node; wall measured 209/262). Esc closes the palette and returns focus to the opener; Enter lands via router.navigate and focuses the spread (l2) or the poster hit button (l1). Recents exclude the current route in the palette, so Ctrl+K, Enter goes back one place.
